description: Bank statement descriptor patterns, matched in order. This file says what the document SAYS — a movement type and a counterparty name. It deliberately says nothing about which channel a credit belongs to or whether it is in scope: those are reconciliation conclusions, and letting ingestion decide them would make the confidence score circular. See ADR-0002.

rules.note: Listed before the fee rule so the more specific prefix wins.
The payer's name follows the prefix. Captured as a fact; whether it is a channel we track is for Phase 2 to decide.
